cd /opt/trading-bot && python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3, json
levels = []
for f in ("ob_wall3.db", "ob_wall4.db"):
    try:
        db = sqlite3.connect("file:%s?mode=ro" % f, uri=True)
        levels += db.execute("select symbol,kind,price,tick,path from levels").fetchall()
    except Exception as e: print(f, e)
TH = [0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50]
for kind in ("wall", "ctrl"):
    fills = []
    for sym, k, price, tick, path in levels:
        if k != kind: continue
        p = json.loads(path); order = price + tick
        i = next((j for j,(t,b) in enumerate(p) if b <= order), None)
        if i is None: continue
        seg = p[i:]
        mx = (max(b for t,b in seg)/order - 1)*100
        mn = (min(b for t,b in seg)/order - 1)*100
        # дошла ли до +X раньше, чем до -0.8
        res = {}
        for th in TH:
            hit = None
            for t,b in seg:
                r = (b/order-1)*100
                if r >= th: hit = "up"; break
                if r <= -0.8: hit = "dn"; break
            res[th] = hit
        fills.append((sym, mx, mn, res, seg[-1][0] - seg[0][0]))
    n = len(fills)
    print("\n[%s] заполнено %d из %d уровней; средний остаток пути %.0f с" % ("стенка" if kind=="wall" else "контроль", n, sum(1 for l in levels if l[1]==kind), sum(f[4] for f in fills)/max(n,1)))
    print("порог роста от входа | дошло до порога (до -0.8%)")
    for th in TH:
        up = sum(1 for f in fills if f[3][th] == "up")
        print("  +%.2f%% | %d из %d = %.0f%%" % (th, up, n, 100*up/max(n,1)))
